∀ (q : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Public) (f : Fin q.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.dim) → ℝ)
  (O : OracleTemplate.Oracle (OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked q.n q.dim) (OracleTemplate.DobocK.LocalReply q.n q.dim)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked q.n q.dim) (seed : O.Seed 1 k),
      O.answer 1 k (0, x) seed = OracleTemplate.DobocK.localOracle q f x) →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (seed : (OracleTemplate.DobocK.dobocK q).Seed 1) (ξ : (j : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 j),
      OracleTemplate.execute O (OracleTemplate.DobocK.dobocK q) (fun x => k) seed ξ =
        OracleTemplate.DobocK.iterate q f k
